verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch ships an official CLI (hopp) explicitly documented for running API test collections and automated monitoring from the terminal, with JUnit report generation for CI integration (hoppscotch-docs-8, hoppscotch-docs-9, hoppscotch-docs-21, hoppscotch-probe-4). However, the evidence never explicitly documents exit-code/fail-on-regression behavior or shows independent hands-on CI pipeline examples. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of non-zero exit codes on test failure, and independent/community confirmation of CI usage.
